Knoxville’s Trusted 24/7
Emergency & Specialty Veterinary Hospital
Animal Emergency & Specialty Center of Knoxville
provides 24-hour emergency veterinary care and advanced specialty medicine for pets throughout Knoxville, Farragut, Oak Ridge, Maryville, Alcoa, Lenoir City, Sevierville, Pigeon Forge, Gatlinburg, Clinton, Powell, Seymour, Kingston and East Tennessee.
Conveniently located at
10213 Kingston Pike in Knoxville
, our AAHA-accredited emergency and specialty veterinary hospital provides compassionate, state-of-the-art
emergency care, critical care, internal medicine, surgery, oncology, anesthesia, diagnostic imaging, and advanced specialty care.
Emergency services are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including walk-ins, urgent cases, and immediate veterinary referrals. Specialty referral services are available Monday through Friday during regular business hours.
Trusted by pet owners and referring veterinarians and throughout Tennessee
, our hospital is staffed by experienced emergency clinicians and board-certified specialists who work together to provide
exceptional patient care
. On-site veterinarians are available around the clock, supported by a highly trained nursing and support team, ensuring pets receive timely, expert care at every hour of the day.
Contact Us
Why Knoxville Pet Owners & Referring Veterinarians Trust Animal Emergency & Specialty Center
Knoxville families and referring veterinarians throughout East Tennessee praise our hospital for compassionate, expert, and around-the-clock emergency and specialty veterinary care.
"We are so grateful that we took our little dog to Animal Emergency and Specialty Services. All of the doctors, techs and staff were amazing. They treated our fur baby as if she was their own. She got to come home after 2 nights and has been doing wonderful. So thankful this place is available to us."
- Christy C.
"My dog Lucy is in the middle of getting getting Chemotherapy treatments there right now. She is alive today because of this. The Dr. and staff here are amazing. I whole heartily recommend this office."
- Mary H.
"Dr. Wong preformed surgery on our dog recently, and did an incredible job! Our dog had a quick recovery because of the extremely talented staff. The techs were especially gentle to our nervous dog and took such great care of him before and after the procedure. They were amazing and we highly recommend this clinic!"
- Y H.
"My normal vet was covered up on a Saturday and suggested I take my blue tick to this center for a hematoma on his ear. He encouraged to deal with it immediately. I was concerned taking him to a new vet and when I walked in their door I was quickly met with knowledgeable personnel.  The whole time there was about 2 hours and I was kept updated from the cost to the post care he would need. I would recommend anyone to take their pet and I believe they will have the same experience. Thanks to their staff.”
- Steve N.
“My dog had a total ear canal ablation done
here with Dr. Bohling and the surgery team and I am beyond grateful! They stayed late to complete the procedure as it turned out to be more involved than expected due to the chronic condition of her ear. They were very thorough with at home care when she went home and even checked her twice in the following weeks to make sure she was healing properly. Thanks to them she is living out her golden years in comfort. I highly recommend this hospital for your fur babies needs!
- Tiffany K.
Veterinarians, you can trust our work.
When you refer a patient to us, we recognize that you’re placing confidence in your reputation and our ability to treat your patient successfully. We do everything we can to ensure a positive experience for your client from beginning to end.
We have the expertise to provide support for your patients in the following areas:
Emergency
Critical care
Internal medicine
Surgery
Oncology
Diagnostic imaging
Radiation treatment
If you have a particular case you need help with, we encourage you to contact us right away.
Refer a patient
Emergency
24/7 emergency veterinary care for dogs, cats, and exotic pets across Knoxville and East Tennessee. Our on-site emergency team is ready around the clock for walk-ins, life-threatening illness, trauma, toxin exposure, and other urgent situations. No appointment needed.
Emergency
Critical Care
Advanced critical care for the most fragile patients, including 24-hour intensive monitoring, oxygen therapy, IV fluid and medication management, and continuous support for pets recovering from surgery, trauma, or severe illness.
Critical Care
Internal Medicine
Board-certified internal medicine for the diagnosis and management of complex conditions affecting the gastrointestinal, endocrine, respiratory, urinary, and immune systems; partnering closely with your primary care veterinarian for seamless treatment plans.
Internal Medicine
Surgery
Soft-tissue, orthopedic, and emergency surgical procedures performed by experienced veterinary surgeons in our modern, AAHA-accredited surgical suite, with careful pre-op planning, advanced anesthesia monitoring, and attentive post-op recovery.
Surgery
Emergency
Critical Care
Internal Medicine
Surgery
Oncology
Compassionate cancer care for dogs and cats, including diagnostics, staging, chemotherapy, and quality-of-life-focused treatment planning, helping East Tennessee families navigate a difficult diagnosis with expertise and empathy.
Oncology
Feline Hyperthyroidism
Specialized treatment for feline hyperthyroidism, including I-131 radioactive iodine therapy, a safe, highly effective, single-treatment cure for most affected cats, performed in a dedicated facility by experienced veterinary clinicians.
Feline Hyperthyroidism
Diagnostic Imaging
Advanced diagnostic imaging including digital radiography, ultrasound, and CT to quickly and accurately identify what’s going on with your pet, supporting faster, more confident treatment decisions for emergency and specialty cases alike.
Diagnostic Imaging
Oncology
Feline Hyperthyroidism

We are a top-tier animal hospital
As an American Animal Hospital Association (AAHA)-accredited hospital, we adhere to the Association's rigorous standards in surgery, nursing care, anesthesiology, and diagnostic imaging, and are consistently evaluated by AAHA on over 900 different requirements to maintain our accreditation.
We are proud to be amongst the only 12-15% of animal hospitals that receive this honor by our commitment to our facility, our standard of care, and most importantly, our patients.
